title: Do you see something similar in MW?
content: I dream of my Mall World about 3-4 times a year. Its a strange version of the city I went to college in and next to it is the town I grew up and still live in. The city has many interconnected bridges, mostly narrow roads that I get lost in all the time, a ferris wheel, hobbit like homes that are built in these small hills (in the city) and a mall thats between my town and the city. Though I dont ever remember going in it, I only remember not wanting to go in. Theres also a giant bridge over a large body of water. The area that intrigues me the most is this crater like hole in my town with many grand old homes that are falling apart. Just outside the crater are homes that are being renovated and I always wonder why not the homes in the crater cus they'res so beautiful and full of character, even though they're falling apart. I wanted to know if anyone else has a similar looking area in their dream. Attached is an image of what it sort of looks like. Edit: After posting this, I had the dream again but this crater with the houses wasnt in it. Very bizarre. https://preview.redd.it/p2sa5adrgj7g1.png?width=1024&format=png&auto=webp&s=51f935f5ba35022f4f6107f04d17380debaeb8f3
